Important⚠️ Data Disclaimer

All analyses in this document were performed on synthetic (dummy) data generated to mirror the structure and distributions of the original dataset. Real patient data cannot be shared due to ethical, legal, and patient-privacy constraints.

Methodological validity is preserved — every statistical technique, visualization, and interpretive step reflects what would be applied to the real data.
